clips.title: The story
paras: Along the road to Brill, Gordo gathers plants for the Royal Apothecary Society. The wandering abomination cannot manage delicate work, so he asks travelers to pick Gloom Weed and bring it to Junior Apothecary Holland.

Between Deathknell and Brill, Gordo trudges through the countryside on the Royal Apothecary Society's behalf. Abominations can fight with brute strength and haul heavy loads, but their huge, stitched hands make delicate work difficult. Sent into the meadows to gather ingredients, Gordo finds that his blunt fingers crush more stems than they pluck. He turns to passersby, bullying or bribing them to do the careful work for him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.
When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.
Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... Doom weed!
